scope: All18 TableS1 readings retained,14 accepted; original pressures, mask and fixed2011 EOS coefficients unchanged. No coefficient fitting.

methods.conversion: v=a^3*1e-24*N_A/(4*M), cm3/g; B1 Z=4, M=58.44g/mol, N_A=6.02214076e23/mol; no assumed ambient lattice parameter.
methods.table1: Brown Eqs1-4, TableI p5804, MATLAB SPLINE prescription: not-a-knot cubic splines of P0,gamma,theta; P=P0+gamma*E_D/(v*M)/1000, E_D=18RT*(T/theta)^3*integral_0^(theta/T)[z^3/(exp(z)-1)]dz, J/molNaCl. No zero-point term added to the stated zero-K pressure.
methods.table2: Published TableII p5805 directly interpolated by not-a-knot cubic splines in specific volume and temperature. Above1200K explicitly extend from1200K with TableI gamma/theta Debye energy increment. Below300K inverse-temperature diagnostics extend analogously from300K. No volume extrapolation.
methods.temperature: Tsample=(Tu+Td)/2; Tmarker=(Tsample+300)/2 from2011 paragraph4. Cycle2 sample means confirmed byFigureS1; first-cycle averaging remains inferred.
methods.uncertainty: Only lattice SD propagated by local dP/da. No rowwise temperature uncertainty, calibration covariance or joint sample/marker covariance recovered. Source pressure parentheses have unspecified confidence. These are descriptive central-value comparisons, not significance tests.
methods.half_temperature_diagnostic: For heated rows only, Tmarker=Tsample/2,150K below the stated midpoint. Numerical hypothesis only; neither adopted nor claimed as author workflow. Quenched/preheat states kept at300K.
methods.inverse_temperatures: Solve Brown(VNaCl,Tmarker)=Psource or fixedPmodel over1-4000K; null means no root in that interval. Fractions are null for300K sample states. These are model-conditional diagnostics, not measured gradients. Whole-sample-T scenario is also a diagnostic, not a proposed correction.

primary_table_consistency.assessment: TableI plus normalized Debye energy fails to reproduce TableII at its printed precision: a mostly temperature-independent pressure offset remains. Thermal increments agree within0.016GPa over complete rows. Cause unresolved; preserve both, do not repair either published table or claim exact author calculator recovery.
